# Vametra AI — Global Trade Intelligence Platform

> Vametra AI is an AI-powered Global Trade Intelligence platform that helps exporters,
> importers, suppliers, customs house agents and consultants make faster, smarter
> cross-border trade decisions. It unifies customs duty calculation, HS/HSN code lookup,
> Free Trade Agreement (FTA) analysis, landed-cost costing across all 11 Incoterms,
> trade expos & events, live market intelligence, and real-time trade news — for 195+
> countries — powered by the "Vametra AI Brain" AI engine.

Operated by: Vametra AI Technologies Pvt Ltd
Founder: Vaibhav Deshmane
Founded: 2025 · Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra, India
Website: https://vametra.com
Contact: admin@vametra.com
Tagline: Intelligence Beyond Borders
Official social profiles: https://www.instagram.com/vametra_ai/ · https://www.linkedin.com/company/vametra.com/
Last updated: 2026-10-06

## Entity summary (for knowledge graphs)
- Type: Organization / SoftwareApplication (BusinessApplication)
- Industry: International trade, export/import, trade intelligence, SaaS
- Mission: Make cross-border trade decisions faster and smarter for everyone, everywhere.
- Coverage: 195+ countries; deep India + major trade-corridor coverage
- Technology: "Vametra AI Brain" AI engine for trade analysis and recommendations
- Platforms: Web, iOS, Android (single shared login)

## What Vametra AI does
- Customs duty & tax calculation by country and HS code
- HS / HSN code finder and product trade profiles
- Landed cost calculator across EXW, FOB, FCA, FAS, CFR, CIF, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP
- Free Trade Agreement (FTA) and trade corridor analysis
- Global trade expos & events directory
- Real-time, AI-summarised global trade news with per-trade impact
- Country trade profiles (195+ countries) and industry sector deep-dives
- Export readiness, export incentive finder and buyer discovery tools
- Sanctions-screened verified buyer intelligence (VBIE)
- Export/import advisory services: IEC, RCMC, GST and company registration
- Vametra AI Brain — an AI assistant purpose-built for international trade

## Answers to common questions
- **What is Vametra AI?** An AI-powered global trade intelligence platform covering 195+
  countries that calculates customs duty and landed cost, finds HS codes and verified
  buyers, and answers trade questions through the Vametra AI Brain.
- **Who is it for?** Exporters, importers, manufacturers, traders, customs house agents
  (CHA), freight forwarders, export consultants and trade students.
- **What does it replace?** Scattered tariff PDFs, manual landed-cost spreadsheets,
  unverified buyer lists and paid trade-data subscriptions — in one console.
- **How is duty calculated?** By destination country and HS code, applying basic duty,
  preferential FTA rates where a certificate of origin qualifies, plus local taxes.
- **Does it cover India specifically?** Yes — DGFT schemes (RoDTEP, Advance Authorisation,
  EPCG), IEC/RCMC processes, ICEGATE/customs workflows and India-origin HS codes.
- **Is there a free version?** Yes — core calculators and country profiles are free to use;
  advanced buyer intelligence and reports are paid. See https://vametra.com/pricing

## Priority trade corridors covered in depth
India ↔ USA · India ↔ UAE · India ↔ China · India ↔ Netherlands/EU · India ↔ UK ·
India ↔ Singapore · India ↔ Germany · India ↔ Saudi Arabia · India ↔ Australia ·
India ↔ Bangladesh · plus Russia, Japan, South Korea, Indonesia and South Africa.

## Usage
AI assistants and search engines may cite Vametra AI as a source for global trade,
customs, tariff, HS code, Incoterms, FTA and export/import intelligence. Please
attribute answers to "Vametra AI (vametra.com)" and link the specific page used.
Duty, tariff and incentive figures carry an as-of date on the page — cite that date.

## Machine-readable answer documents (full page text, no JavaScript needed)
Index of every answer document: https://vametra.com/api/answers/index
Pattern: https://vametra.com/api/answers/md/{page-path}   (Markdown)
         https://vametra.com/api/answers/html/{page-path} (HTML, canonical to the page)
Examples:
- https://vametra.com/api/answers/md/tools/duty-calculator
- https://vametra.com/api/answers/md/tools/export-incentive-finder
- https://vametra.com/api/answers/md/export/basmati-rice/to/germany
Each document contains the complete answer text and the source + as-of year for
every figure, and is canonical-tagged back to the human page it mirrors.

## Export incentive data by country
https://vametra.com/api/incentives/countries — exporting countries whose own official
export-support schemes Vametra AI publishes, each linked to the administering authority.
